elements.name: intro_text
elements.html:
Thank you for your participation! You will see 8 videos. Each shows a person performing the described action in a 3D-scanned room, generated by two different methods (1 = left, 2 = right).

For each video, answer which motion is better for each of the 3 questions. Watch the whole clip; the shorter motion holds its last pose until the longer one ends.

elements.name: video_q01
elements.html: Text: A man does sit-ups on the roman chair

elements.name: text__q01
elements.title: Which motion follows the text description better?

elements.name: physics__q01
elements.title: Which motion interacts with the scene more plausibly (no body parts passing through objects, no floating, no sliding)?

elements.name: overall__q01
elements.title: Which motion looks better overall?
